svg.text: Release, required vars, controller IP in
Tooling in, legacy services out, one firewall,
ufw told to load the CIS sysctl file
NTP servers replace the public pools
TMOUT and umask for interactive shells
AIDE installed, baseline built in the
(tag) = run only that part, e.g. --tags ssh,sudo
